verdict.rationale: Fastmail has a public JMAP API, so an interactive API reference is a fair question for this product. The evidence shows only static documentation: a developer page pointing to the session endpoint, with the IETF RFCs serving as the full API specification. Probes found no OpenAPI or Swagger spec, and nothing in the pack describes an interactive explorer or runnable examples.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
